copy.heroHeadline: Translation and localization for clients around the world
copy.heroSubheadline: Careful translation of documents, websites and video calls between English and many other languages, from a small team in Seattle.
copy.about: Lingo Bridge is a small team of translators and editors based in Seattle. Every project is translated by a native speaker and checked by a second linguist before it goes back to you.

sectionIntros.services: Send us your files and target languages and we reply with a quote.
sectionIntros.faq: What clients ask before a first project.
sectionIntros.contact: Tell us the languages and the deadline and we will reply with a quote.

serviceDescriptions.description: Contracts, manuals and reports translated by native speakers and checked by a second linguist.
Your pages and menus adapted for each market, with dates, units and spelling to match.
An interpreter joins your video call for meetings, interviews and training.
A careful second read of text you already have translated, with every change tracked.

faq.question: Which languages do you work in?
faq.answer: Our core languages are Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Japanese. Ask us about others.

faq.question: Do you work with clients abroad?
faq.answer: Yes. We work by email and video with clients worldwide, across time zones.

faq.question: How is a project priced?
faq.answer: By the word for most documents, with a minimum per project. We send a written quote before we start.
